headline: EOHLC contract for $489,967.63, a credit card limit of $50,000, and a 95-day extension for Toepfert Phase III.
summary: Other items cover signing authority for two assistant executive directors and closings on South Holyoke Homes Phase II homeownership units. Nine department reports are also on the list.
items: Accept EOHLC Contract for Financial Assistance 17 for $489,967.63
Change the credit card policy to allow limits up to $50,000 in certain situations
Approve a no-cost 95-day time extension, Change Order No. 1, for Toepfert Phase III Apartment Modernization
Authorize both assistant executive directors to sign documents for housing authority operations
Authorize both assistant executive directors to sign agreements and deeds to close on South Holyoke Homes Phase II homeownership units
Nine department reports, including maintenance and finance

Thursday, September 3, 2026, at 12:00 PM 
475 Maple Street, Holyoke, MA 
 
 
AGENDA:
